build._comment: Dockerfile rather than Nixpacks: Nixpacks always copies package-lock.json before installing, which triggers npm/cli#4828 and leaves Tailwind v4's Linux native binary unresolved. The Dockerfile installs from package.json alone.

deploy._comment2: First boot creates the SQLite schema and seeds baseline hospitals, doctors and medicines before the server accepts traffic, so allow well over the usual start time.
